answer: The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, released only after three unrelated confirmations, rewards vest against future work. The quill is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the orchard. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. By the ledge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
